findings.title: Pass the query results to the new table visualization
findings.body: When an organization has `use-table-widget-visualization`, every table widget receives empty columns, empty data, and empty metadata instead of the fetched `result`. Consequently, enabling the feature makes populated dashboard tables appear empty. Wire the actual fields, rows, and metadata into the new visualization rather than substituting an empty table.

findings.title: Normalize error and recording timestamps before merging
findings.body: Stored Sentry error timestamps are Unix seconds, while rrweb recording events use Unix milliseconds. Comparing these values directly emits all contemporary errors before the first recording event, regardless of when they actually occurred. The generated error messages also send seconds alongside recording timestamps in milliseconds. Normalize both sources to the same units before comparison and serialization, and use millisecond recording timestamps in the regression tests.

findings.title: Include the organization in the attribute query cache key
findings.body: The new React Query key contains only request options, but the request URL depends on the organization. Two organizations using the all-projects selection and the same relative date range have identical keys. Switching organizations can therefore reuse the previous organization's custom attributes, and changing the query function alone does not reliably trigger a fetch. Include the organization slug in the key to isolate these cached results.

findings.title: Escape issue titles before embedding them in Markdown links
findings.body: Issue titles are now inserted directly inside Markdown link text. A normal title containing an unmatched closing bracket, such as `SyntaxError: Unexpected token ]`, prematurely closes the link text and prevents the issue URL from rendering as a link. Previously, the separate `View Issue` link remained usable regardless of the title. Escape Markdown delimiters in the truncated title before formatting the link, and cover bracket-containing titles in tests.

findings.title: Respect falsy results from custom cell renderers
findings.body: The custom-renderer contract specifies that `undefined` requests fallback rendering, but this truthiness check also falls back for valid React nodes such as `0`, an empty string, `false`, or `null`. For example, a renderer returning `null` to suppress a cell instead displays the underlying value. The header renderer has the same problem. Check explicitly for `undefined` rather than testing whether the result is truthy.

findings.title: Allow valid non-HTTP document URLs in browser reports
findings.body: A Reporting API report's URL identifies the reporting document and can validly be `about:blank` or a `blob:` URL, for example for a policy violation in an iframe inheriting its parent's policy. DRF's `URLField` uses Django's URL validator, which rejects these schemes. An otherwise valid report therefore causes the entire batch to return 422, losing metrics for every report in that batch. Validate against the Reporting API document-URL contract rather than the HTTP/FTP URL restriction.

findings.title: Exercise null-segment deletion without mocking away the fix
findings.body: The null-segment case is added to a test that patches `delete_matched_rows`, so it never reaches `_make_recording_filenames`, where a null maximum segment ID previously raised `TypeError`. This test would still pass if the new guard were removed. Add a regression test that executes the helper or deletion use case and verifies that a null-segment replay produces no recording filenames without failing.
